examples.text: Ibuprofen is one of several new drugs used for the treatment of various types of arthritis. All these drugs reduce inflammation, and share the same side effects, the most common of which is possible formation of ulcers and upset stomach.
examples.ref: 1979, Harold M. Silverman, Gilbert I. Simon, “Ibuprofen”, in The Pill Book […] , 1st edition, New York: Bantam Books, →ISBN, page 164:

raw_glosses: (organic chemistry, pharmacology) A synthetic compound used widely as an analgesic and anti-inflammatory drug.
